mechanism_narrative: A rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% MoM for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases > 1% MoM for 3 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market weakness, leading to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% MoM and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines > 1% MoM and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS is below 1% and CPIAUCSL is above 3% YoY, the real interest rate is negative, signaling accommodative monetary policy and inflationary pressure, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) coupled with a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening economy, boosting consumer confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% MoM
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 5% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% MoM and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases consistently and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) signals a weakening economy, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines > 1% QoQ and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.
